- **Two-finger pinch**: Note 1 says "A two-finger pinch still writes radius at once." Also confirmed by **Note 22**: "attachControl's two-finger pinch writes radius directly, scaling it by start distance / current distance, before any frame runs and with no inertial offset." So pinch **does change radius immediately**, even without a scene.
